select from phone_one_tap_attempts where token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update
mapper.update: update phone_one_tap_attempts set lease_id = #{leaseId}, lease_expires_time = #{leaseExpiresTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_id = #{expectedLeaseId}
